header.description: What: bt-range (CE-5027 / CE-5030, base edits BE-1; docs/DESIGN_Terrain_Base_Edits.md §7): the scenario carries ONE building edit — 'Remove building' on House A (baked into the terrain, x 100..110 on the west-east line y 103.5) — and 'Walker' (Friend rifleman at (93,103.5)) is ordered to (117,103.5), straight through where the house stood. Judge: with the house gone (bare levelled ground, no walls) he walks the straight line — never more than 1.5 m off y 103.5 — crosses the old footprint (x past 105) and ends within 1.5 m of (117,103.5). With the house still there he would have to go round it (its walls run across the line), so the line check is what proves the removal.
